note: Robe reel (Shkolnik et al., Nature 1980). Sets: park (l01-l03, l07-l09), lab (l04-l05), cutaway (l06). stick05-q3: same script, voice, acting and sets; shots planned from each line role (engine/shotplan.js). stick06: combined kit. Every fx is in the world (steam haze, sparks glint, smoke column of warm air, cool-air wisps, a 41°C park sign, a hanging 1980 sign, thermometers); floating text is the label budget: +6°C, SAME, AIR GAP (3). Every line names its body acting in `act`. stick07 (forensic fixes): no floating text (+6°C, SAME, AIR GAP are signs in the world); l02/l04/l08 open establishing, l05 wide (wide share >= 30 %); acts dissolve; own light per act.

lines.see: Under a blazing sun in the park, heat haze rises off the path and a 41°C HOTTEST DAY sign stands behind Wren in all white and Bram in all black; Bram shades his eyes, Wren shrugs: who cooks first?
Wren points at Bram; sunlight glints off Wren's white shirt in sparks, while warm orange wisps rise off Bram's black one as it soaks the sun up.
Close on Bram, heat haze rising off his black robe and a +6°C stamp slamming in beside him; he flails.
In a lab a hanging 1980 FIELD TEST sign drops in, a thermometer pops up beside Wren and Bram and both climb as the heat reaches the body.
Both thermometers read exactly the same level and a big SAME stamp slams in between Wren and Bram.
Cutaway: a black robe cylinder swings open to show the body inside with a wide air gap round it, labelled AIR GAP.
Back in the sun, heat haze rises off Bram's black robe and a warm column of air billows up out of his neck.
Cool blue air wisps drift in from both sides at his feet and up under the robe; Bram laughs in the breeze.
Bram hugs the robe tight, the cool wisps stop, the thermometer shoots to 400 and Bram slumps in thick heat haze. The hot path cracks red under him.
